heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: When two options are opposites (hasten/postpone, impede/assist, call/dismiss), pick one of the pair; the other is likely the antonym trap

heuristics.name: classic-synonym-target
heuristics.description: Pick the option that is a common ISEE synonym target for a harder headword (cunning~wily, agile~nimble, fleeting~ephemeral)

notes: No option was certainly excludable without the headword; reject_certain false throughout.
